extraction.serialization: Lossless JSON transfer: consecutive runs of two or more ASCII spaces encoded as integer lengths, all other copied characters retained; exactly decoded before UTF-8 writing
extraction.text_transformation: none; no trimming, Markdown reformatting, newline substitution, citation editing or paraphrase
extraction.file_writer: Documented general node_repl with node:fs/promises, Buffer UTF-8, exclusive-create writes
extraction.copied_string_fidelity: FNV-1a over UTF-16 code units and exact lengths matched between browser capture and decoded file input; FNV is a transfer check, not a cryptographic or completeness proof
extraction.completeness_basis: Full existing prompt and answer present in the page through the answer final Status paragraph and response controls; actual complete clipboard strings saved. Prior character counts are corroboration only.
